宋志杰 / 品牌内容创意 · 游戏视觉设计: Song Zhijie / Brand content creative · Game visual design
你好呀，欢迎来到卷卷宇宙汪！: Hello! Welcome to Juanjuan’s universe, woof!
MLBB 26Y朋友节，重点塑造的品牌形象为全年社交新玩法最多的节点 + 让ML: For MLBB 26Y Friends Fest, the brand image focuses on the event with the most new social gameplay throughout the year + giving MLBB players a richer social experience.
以“点赞”的战场表情作为核心图形，战场信号作为辅助图形，营造朋友快乐交流的轻松氛: Use the battlefield thumbs-up emote as the core graphic and battlefield signals as supporting graphics to create a relaxed atmosphere of friends happily communicating; continue using yellow as the main color to reinforce the event's cheerful, relaxed and social character in users' minds.
MLBB 26yAS 基于深海主题战场，建立整体规范的视觉体系，视觉层面塑造“海: Based on a deep-sea-themed battlefield, MLBB 26y AS establishes an overall standardized visual system, shaping the event's character of confrontation in the abyss and a gold-rush frenzy.
以“具有攻击性的触手”的核心图形和“深渊凝视”的底纹，营造视觉冲击力和心理暗示；: Use aggressive tentacles as the core graphic and an abyssal gaze as the background texture to create visual impact and psychological suggestion; use cyan-blue as the main color for the deep-sea tone, with red and gold as supporting colors echoing the mild-horror and gold-rush atmosphere, differentiating the event through mild-horror visuals.
MLBB 25y MYHERO，基于为爱投票的活动主题推导和探索视觉风格/色彩/: For MLBB 25y MYHERO, derive and explore visual styles/colors/graphic elements from the vote-for-love theme, supporting the hero UGC event's in-game display and short-form external graphic materials.
玩家为角色投票、角色为玩家赢得高光，双方都为彼此而战，满腔热血。从同人创作的UG: Players vote for characters, and characters win highlight moments for players; both fight for each other with passion. Start with the classic comic-graffiti style in fan-created UGC culture, incorporating transformed hearts, crowns and lane symbols into the logo. The original user post-survey perception was strong, successfully establishing recognition of the brand event.
MLBB 26y MYHERO，延用去年slogan主题基础上，保持大赛理念传递: For MLBB 26y MYHERO, continue last year's slogan theme to maintain consistency in communicating the contest's concept, deepen users' impression that love is the starting point, and connect with the tenth anniversary.
用王冠和爱心、星星结合，传达玩家对英雄的爱、为其戴冠，呼应Slogan叙事和十周: Combine a crown with hearts and stars to convey players' love for heroes and crowning them, echoing the slogan narrative and the tenth-anniversary connection. Retain the basic MY HERO crown logo shape while iterating and upgrading its material, providing new visual highlights while preserving player recognition.
MLBB与SF联动，面对格斗类玩家用户，一方面强调玩家在开局时的内心正如同格斗家: For the MLBB and SF collaboration targeting fighting-game players, emphasize that players' excitement at the start of a match is like a fighter standing in the ring as a bout begins, while also showing skin details.
用IP色代表角色，也代表不同玩家开局时情绪色（红色冲劲、蓝色专注、绿色冷静、橙色: Use IP colors to represent characters and different players' emotions at the start of a match (red for drive, blue for focus, green for calm and orange for excitement), using an outward-expanding composition to express the concentrated eruption of these emotions. The heroes stand on high ground, poised to act, conveying the key message ROUND 1 excitement.
KV满意度82.8%，玩家最满意的是角色皮肤/技能特效（占比58.3%），其次是: KV satisfaction was 82.8%. Players were most satisfied with character skins/skill effects (58.3%), followed by the combination of Round 1 and MLBB (49.3%), indicating that the skins effectively attracted players and ROUND 1 was successfully recognized, establishing a memory of the collaboration.
26Y朋友节作为全年唯一IP联动送主角：联动东南亚知名IP《降世神通：最后的气宗: As the year's only IP collaboration event giving away the protagonist, 26Y Friends Fest collaborates with the well-known Southeast Asian IP Avatar: The Last Airbender. The main KV creates a happy, joyful and relaxed gaming social experience.
定格安昂、卡塔拉和ml英雄一次完美配合达成后，互赞的瞬间。除角色露出外，增加农场: Freeze the moment when Aang, Katara and ML heroes give each other thumbs-up after a perfect coordinated play. In addition to showing the characters, include the farm setting and crop selling points to strengthen Friends Fest's multiple social gameplay messages, conveying the relaxed and joyful event atmosphere through stylized graffiti and MVP lettering.
配合AS节点微恐调性，视觉化呈现深海战斗氛围，重点让玩家直观感受到新皮肤的细节亮: In line with the AS event's mild-horror tone, visualize the deep-sea combat atmosphere, focusing on giving players a direct sense of the new skins' detailed highlights.
模拟沉船里的窗户视角，让玩家身处深海，面向近在眼前的危险。触手缠上碎裂的沉船窗户: Simulate a view through a shipwreck window, placing players deep underwater facing danger close at hand. Tentacles wrap around the shattered shipwreck window, while the hero squad outside battles the siren ahead. Clearly show the combat confrontation and hero skin details.
配套KV综合满意度76.94%，节点的信息内容有效触达玩家，翀的皮肤质量等引起玩: The accompanying KVs had an overall satisfaction of 76.94%. The event's information effectively reached players, with discussions about the quality of Chong's skin and other topics.
AS节点拥有年度最大主题地图（深海版本）+全局玩法(淘金主题)，需要通过“周大福: The AS event has the year's largest themed map (deep-sea version) + global gameplay (gold-rush theme). A Chow Tai Fook collaboration KV is needed to establish players' understanding of the event's deep-sea gold-rush experience.
主角翀在深海淘到真金，放大“real gold”信息，配合BD活动，直观展示真金: The protagonist Chong finds real gold in the deep sea. Amplify the real gold message and, alongside the BD event, directly display real gold jewelry, emphasizing the real gold information to bring players the event's biggest reward.
配套KV综合满意度76.94%，节点的信息内容有效触达玩家，真金奖励内容、活动讨: The accompanying KVs had an overall satisfaction of 76.94%. The event's information effectively reached players, prompting discussions about real gold rewards, the event and other topics.
25yUGCkv，作为MLBB全年英雄共创生态最高点，需要撬动全民创作热情，传达: As the high point of MLBB's annual hero co-creation ecosystem, the 25y UGC KV needs to inspire everyone's creative enthusiasm and communicate the core concept: encouraging players to create and support the heroes they love.
挑选高人气英雄，让英雄们跃起在高空中，下方是玩家搭建的虚拟城市。冲破云层形成爱心: Select popular heroes and have them leap into the sky above a virtual city built by players. Breaking through clouds into a heart shape represents the stage players have built with love. The flying design tickets reference and visually refine the in-game voting tickets, echoing the in-game voting event.
奖杯在中心四射出斗魂火焰，特效中是联动小小指挥官们，整体朝向中心，准备迎接新一季: The trophy radiates fighting-spirit flames from the center. The collaboration's Little Commanders appear in the effects, all facing the center, ready to welcome a new season of the open tournament.
全民参赛无限制，新人和大佬同台竞技，凭策略和运气来获得荣誉。每个小小指挥官都离奖: Everyone can enter without restrictions. Newcomers and experts compete together, earning honors through strategy and luck. Every Little Commander is close to the trophy; with no entry barrier, they come from all directions to compete for the trophy and honor.
游戏全球上线，小小指挥官们闪耀登场，邀请面前的你一起加入战斗！: The game launches globally. The Little Commanders make a dazzling entrance and invite you in front of them to join the battle!
金马开道送真金，仅用16天时间，完成了春节主视觉的草图创意到最终动态落地，按时完: A golden horse leads the way to real gold. In only 16 days, the Lunar New Year key visual was completed from creative sketch to final animation, delivered on time with quality recognized internally and externally.
服务于全渠道吸量，展示联动亮点（6大角色，一次集结），需要一次性展示6大人气角色: Serve acquisition across all channels and show the collaboration's highlight (six major characters assembled together). Show the six popular character skin announcement KVs at once, creating a sense of confrontation.
基于25ynext四个端内地图玩法，在CG里做视觉化表达，通过四个不同的英雄角色: Visualize the four in-game map mechanics of 25y NEXT in the CG. Through four different heroes discovering new places for matches in NEXT's updated maps, convey the NEXT MAP CHANGE gameplay experience of opening another battlefield and showing your skills.
承接CG与美术的美术概设反馈、模型监修。重点强化高概念战场的美术设计和 MLBB: Handle art-concept feedback and model supervision for CG and art. Focus on differentiating the high-concept battlefield art from MLBB's optimized Sanctum Island art so players have a deeper and clearer understanding of the version's map changes.
CG满意度77.47%，完播比达75.9%，有效传递”新地图玩法“信息，玩家表示: CG satisfaction was 77.47% and the completion ratio reached 75.9%, effectively communicating the new map gameplay information. Players said the new gameplay was clear and they were willing to try it.
在9周年庆节点物料基础上，借h5的玩法晒徽章，释放福利加码信息，刺激玩家收集徽章: Based on the ninth-anniversary event materials, use the H5 badge-sharing gameplay to release information about additional rewards, encourage players to collect badges, and help bring players back into the game.
从玩家视觉审美偏好出发，使用趣味调性的扁平绘制风格，结合端内活动的玩法，设计创作: Starting from players' visual aesthetic preferences, use a playful flat illustration style, combined with the in-game event's gameplay, to design and create 23 badges and landscape/portrait backgrounds, improving the H5's visual appeal and enabling player interaction.
h5点击率破新高，撬动情感杠杆增强与玩家联结，使用户认知ML生日是年度\"超有情: The H5 click-through rate reached a new high, using emotional appeal to strengthen connections with players and establish ML's birthday as an annual highly heartfelt celebration of giving back, increasing return visits and maintaining activity. Returning players said they liked it very much, and younger players said they were willing to share, stimulating emotional sharing.
MLBB-26yAS节点，icon迭代、五图等物料制作。: MLBB-26y AS event: icon iterations, five-image store sets and other materials.
25yUGC答谢视频，UGC投票结束后，需制作TOP1英雄致谢物料，回应玩家的投: For the 25y UGC thank-you video, after UGC voting ends, thank-you materials for the TOP1 hero are needed to respond to players' voting results. Independently followed the production of animated video content for the first time, proposing animated camera movement to improve quality and show the contrast between Granger's childhood experiences and his current popularity, using that contrast to reach players emotionally.
从角色设定上出发，让人气TOP1英雄「格兰杰」站在修道院的礼堂中，拉起小提琴感谢: Starting from the character setting, have the TOP1 hero Granger stand in the monastery hall and play the violin to thank players for their votes. Use camera movement to contrast his cute childhood with his current cool appearance; this charming contrast appeals to players and received unanimously positive feedback.
对JOC奖杯的视觉及品牌内核进行全面升级。从金铲铲赛事的价值概念出发，讲品牌故事: Comprehensively upgrade the JOC trophy's visuals and brand core. Start from the values of the TFT tournament to tell the brand story and create a high-quality trophy with a story and spirit. Use internationally simple visuals and concepts to convey the tournament spirit of participation and social connection for everyone.

不依托IP做地图场景的整体换肤和融合，而从视觉上放大朋友节节点氛围：: Rather than reskinning and merging the entire map around the IP, visually amplify the Friend Fest atmosphere:
和朋友一起轻松、热闹、愉快感受的视觉翻译: A visual translation of the relaxed, lively and joyful experience of being with friends
朋友间互相碰撞的社交反应的视觉转化: A visual translation of the social reactions sparked between friends
“分头行动效果有限” 和“好友集合，欢乐全开” 的前后视觉差异: The visual contrast between “limited results when acting separately” and “friends together, fun unleashed”
